subject: reject in ode system function allowed?

messages.author: 97d82fedb7016adb
messages.subject: reject in ode system function allowed?
parts:
Hi!

Is it admissable to have a reject statement in the system function of a ODE; and does it work there? I know this is bad from a sampling perspective, but this could be a reasonable strategy to keep Stan from exploring weird parameter spaces (mostly during warmup).

Best,
Sebastian

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] reject in ode system function allowed?
parts:
The reject should propagate all the way back to the
sampler --- at least I don't think there's anything in
the Boost integrator that'll try to catch and deal with errors.
Definitely won't be in CVODE, since it's C code, but then
I don't know what'll happen to exceptions raised in a C++
callout to C.

We should figure it out for the doc at least, though.

- Bob
